question: Which one of the following river has the highest number of glaciers in the area of its origin ?
solution:
The Correct answer is Option 3. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 The river with the highest number of glaciers in the area of its origin is the Ganga River, particularly in its upper reaches in the Gangotri Glacier region of Uttarakhand.
